RpcRetry._comment: Short budgets: the suite fakes the agent and makes GetStatus/Cancel/Complete throw to prove pause semantics; the 120s production default would make each such test wait two minutes.

VariableEncryption._comment: Random 32-byte key committed here because it's test-only infrastructure — decrypting local integration-test DB variables. Production deploys MUST set their own via env / appsettings override. Fail-fast guard in VariableEncryptionService rejects all-zero and empty keys (P0-B.1, 2026-04-24 audit).
